title: Uni-Fuels Renews ISCC Certification Following Successful Inaugural Biofuel Delivery
summary: After its ISCC-certified biofuel delivery in 2025, Uni-Fuels secures ISCC EU and ISCC PLUS renewals to support compliance with EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime.
body_markdown:
On the day this news was published, **UFG** gained **12.75%** , reflecting a significant positive market reaction. Argus tracked a peak move of **+23.2%** during that session. Our momentum scanner triggered **30 alerts** that day, indicating elevated trading interest and price volatility. This price movement added approximately **$5M** to the company's valuation, bringing the market cap to **$41.49M** at that time. Trading volume was above average at **1.7x** the daily average, suggesting increased trading activity.
